# Easy Minesweeper

Easy Minesweeper is a calm, offline-first minesweeper that runs entirely in your browser
at https://easyminesweeper.vercel.app. It is a single-player logic game with five modes
(classic, no-guess, daily, rush, zen) plus a practice mode, solver-backed teaching hints,
records and achievements stored only on your device, and a PWA shell that keeps working
fully offline once loaded.

Think clearly. Clear everything.

Made by Arun Neupane (https://github.com/arundada9000).

- Home: https://easyminesweeper.vercel.app/
